en.caption: The Griffiths–Squibb comparison shows where G3ZIL has higher paired SNR than G4HZX. Hatched sectors have observations but insufficient qualifying support; they are not measured zeroes.

The same comparison gives a +7.0 dB median across spot pairs and +6.5 dB across station medians. Comparing the distributions shows why observation weighting and station weighting answer different questions.

In the Vanhamel antenna-rotation example, the M7AEO path shows a clear change around 8 May. Read the dated observations before the combined UTC-hour view; the displayed result includes the preset +1.6 dB Reference correction.
Follow DJ0ABR at JN68nt down to individual cycles. The first displayed pair has −14 dB at G4HZX and +3 dB at G3ZIL, giving ΔSNR = +17 dB; subsequent rows show that the difference varies.
